name: M2 — Minor Change Program
description: Minor variant, trim, or feature-level change to an existing platform — facelifts, engine re-tunes, feature add-ons. Lowest engineering risk of the three vehicle programs.

name: M4 — Major Change Program
description: Substantial redesign within an existing platform family — new body variant, major powertrain change, or significant styling refresh. Moderate engineering and validation scope.

name: M6 — New Platform / Breakthrough Program
description: All-new platform or breakthrough product line with no prior-generation baseline. Highest engineering risk — every gate runs at full validation rigor.

name: Exploration — Pre-Concept Feasibility
description: Lightweight feasibility study run before a program is chartered, to test market/technical rationale. Converts into an M2/M4/M6 program if approved at CVPA, or is shelved.
